_note: BOOK-ALIGNED sofa builds — the account book's own decoded text, NOT the owner's drawings. Every entry here exists because the ERP carried a bare -1S (or a partial) placeholder while AutoCount's Desc2 states the build out loud and the decoder reads it cleanly. These are the 31 documents the 2026-09-08 sales-order tally listed under 'DIFFER, and it is work' on the sofa-compartment axis. They are NOT owner rulings and must never be described as such: the owner's own readings live in sofa-compartment-corrections-2026-08.json and -2026-09.json, and his drawing overrides the book ONLY on the documents named in those two files. Because the target build here EQUALS the book, a document corrected from this file reports AGREE, never RULED — RULED is reachable only where the ERP differs from the book by his decision, and it is checked after the multiset has already agreed or not.
_rules: Money never moves: the price rides the FIRST piece and every other piece is 0, exactly as the importer wrote it. Lines are matched to target pieces and UPDATED in place so a row id - and any purchase allocation hanging off it - survives. desc2Match is the WHOLE Desc2 text of the line, because four of these documents carry TWO sofa lines whose texts share a prefix (HC-SO-005013 '60cm 3RR' and '60cm 2S'), and a short needle would put one build's answer on the other build's rows. NO SEAT is written by any entry: the book states many of these in centimetres, variants.seatHeight holds bare inches, and the seat axis reads ZERO differences on the 2026-09-08 tally - a repair that moved it would be creating work, not closing it.
